purpose: This silver table cleans the bronze nyc_flights capture of 2013 domestic flight departures from the NYC-area airports EWR, JFK, and LGA, casting decimal-encoded numeric fields to proper integers and the time_hour string to a timestamp, and dropping Airbyte capture metadata, to feed downstream flight-delay and on-time-performance analytics.
usage: Consumers should treat year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin, dest, and sched_dep_time as the row grain and must explicitly handle null dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time values as likely cancelled or diverted flights rather than coercing them to zero or silently filtering them out.
limitations: Cleanup could not resolve why dep_time/dep_delay (null_rate 0.0294), arr_time/arr_delay (null_rate 0.0307-0.0330), and air_time (null_rate 0.0330) are missing for roughly 3% of the 166158 rows, nor why tailnum is missing for 0.9% of rows; duplicate_row_rate was 0.0 so no dedupe logic was applied, but there is no cancellation flag in this bronze source to confirm the missing-timing hypothesis.
